Serendipity Wines Import Partners
Serendipity Wines is honored to represent these unique importers of wine & spirits from around the world.  It is with great privilege that we distribute these collections of fine products creating experiences and memories for our partners and their customers.

Aquitaine Wine Company

Founded in 2002 in Bordeaux by Jean-Christophe and Margaret Calvet, Aquitaine Wine Company has earned its reputation by championing progressive, family-owned estates throughout Bordeaux. Over time, their portfolio has grown beyond Bordeaux to include exceptional wines from the South of France, Languedoc-Roussillon, the Loire Valley, and the Rhône—always with an unwavering focus on quality and authenticity. (show less)

Arano
Serendipity is proud to partner with Arano USA, an exclusive importer of authentic, regional wines from Spain from an ever-expanding core of artisan producers. Their objective is to ... (read more)
Serendipity is proud to partner with Arano USA, an exclusive importer of authentic, regional wines from Spain from an ever-expanding core of artisan producers. Their objective is to identify, import and build a portfolio of exceptional and distinctive wines from around the world, and to do it well. Arano USA believes in partnership and takes great pride in representing their amazing producers. Relationships and social responsibility are at the forefront of the business. The wineries Arano represents embrace sustainable and social practices and do their part to help preserve lands for future generations. Their producers’ roots are deeply planted in their history of traditional winemaker, thoughtful incorporation of new innovation, and above all, an appreciation of creating amazing wine. (show less)

Banville Wine Merchants
Lia Tolaini Banville started Banville Wine Merchants as a boutique importer of Italian fine wines and Menabrea beer in 2004. Lia had the desire to grow her company yet keep regional ... (read more)
Lia Tolaini Banville started Banville Wine Merchants as a boutique importer of Italian fine wines and Menabrea beer in 2004. Lia had the desire to grow her company yet keep regional exclusives with her suppliers, which led her in 2016 to expand the portfolio outside of Italy, adding top wine producers from France, Germany and UK. In the process Lia also put together a selected portfolio of specialty Italian spirits. Today the Import portfolio represents over 50 hand-picked brands. Serendipity joined forces with Banville as a distribution partner in July of 2021, and we are thrilled to bring selections from their impressive portfolio to the state of California. (show less)

Bowler Imports
It's our challenge and our mission to build a company with a diverse portfolio that is focused almost exclusively on small growers, especially ones who practice a non-interventionist ... (read more)
It's our challenge and our mission to build a company with a diverse portfolio that is focused almost exclusively on small growers, especially ones who practice a non-interventionist approach in the vineyard and in the cellar. We work with winemakers and distillers who respect their land and their history, who do not use a lot of chemicals in their farming nor rely on corrections in their winenmaking and distilling process. We strive to run the company in a way that values our employees and our customers, and provides excellent service by a knowledgeable and professional staff.  
The company was founded in the fall of 2003 with a small but solid book of German and French wines and two employees. With a small list of wines, a vision, and a lot of ambition, Bowler began to sell wine to key accounts in New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania. Since then, we have grown to 38 employees and expanded our portfolio considerably. Today we represent wines from most of the major wine regions in the world and work with many of the regions' leaders in quality. In 2016 we acquired our spirits license and have been adding small batch, hand-crafted spirits to our book, too. And we're still growing: we have developed a strong national presence as an importer and our wines and spirits can now be found in many major markets throughout the country. (show less)

Broadbent Selections
Founded in 1996 by renowned wine expert Bartholomew Broadbent, Broadbent Selections has earned a reputation as one of the most respected and dynamic importers in the U.S. wine industry. ... (read more)
Founded in 1996 by renowned wine expert Bartholomew Broadbent, Broadbent Selections has earned a reputation as one of the most respected and dynamic importers in the U.S. wine industry. Known for curating a diverse and distinctive portfolio, Broadbent focuses on family-owned, high-quality wineries that embody authenticity, tradition, and exceptional value.  
From iconic producers in Portugal, including some of the finest Ports and Madeiras, to hidden gems from South Africa, Austria, and beyond, Broadbent’s carefully chosen selections reflect a dedication to craftsmanship and a deep respect for heritage. With a passion for storytelling and a commitment to education, Broadbent Selections connects wine lovers with remarkable wines that have a sense of place and purpose.  
At Serendipity Wines, we are proud to represent Broadbent Selections' thoughtfully assembled South African portfolio — a collection that celebrates the artistry of winemaking and brings some of the world’s most compelling wines to your table. (show less)

Dark Star Wines
Dark Star Wines is a national wine and spirits importer and wholesaler based in New York City.  
Our commitment is to build a sustainable and strong partnership with our wineries, who ... (read more)
Dark Star Wines is a national wine and spirits importer and wholesaler based in New York City.  
Our commitment is to build a sustainable and strong partnership with our wineries, who are family owned and use estate grown fruit, offering the best and an excellent value to our customers.   
We venture with partners that use organic and biodynamic farming practices, those that focus on sustainability over long periods of time. Honestly, transparency and quality comes first and that is what drives us. Long term sustainability within the vineyards should also translate through the entire operation of the wine business. (show less)

De Maison Selections
De Maison Selections imports exceptional wines, ciders, sherries, and spirits from independent producers in Spain and France. Founder André Tamers built the company in 1996 on a simple ... (read more)
De Maison Selections imports exceptional wines, ciders, sherries, and spirits from independent producers in Spain and France. Founder André Tamers built the company in 1996 on a simple rule: work only with growers who own and farm their own land, skip the negociants and bulk cooperatives entirely. That discipline shows up in the glass — a portfolio weighted toward Spain's overlooked appellations, handled with cold-chain rigor from vineyard to bottle.  
The book leans into categories few importers bother with: Txakoli, cider, and vermouth alongside more familiar Rioja and Cava, much of it sourced from small, multi-generational estates in regions like Galicia, the Basque Country, and Priorat. De Maison was also among the first US importers to bring quality Spanish wine into keg and can formats, a bet on freshness and provenance that's paid off with restaurant buyers looking for something different by the glass.  
We're proud to bring De Maison's Spanish and French portfolio to our Texas accounts, wines with real provenance and a story worth telling table-side. (show less)

Diamond Wine Importers
Diamond Wine Importers was founded in 1992 by Ted Diamantis on a bet that Greece — with its mountain vineyards, volcanic and alluvial soils, and more than 200 indigenous grape varieties ... (read more)
Diamond Wine Importers was founded in 1992 by Ted Diamantis on a bet that Greece — with its mountain vineyards, volcanic and alluvial soils, and more than 200 indigenous grape varieties — was poised to reclaim its place among the world's great wine regions. Over three decades of traveling and tasting throughout Greece and the Greek Isles, Diamantis built a portfolio of artisan, vineyard-driven producers committed to quality and sustainability from vine to bottle.  
The book centers on Greece's native varietals and ancient appellations, from Assyrtiko on Santorini to Vidiano in Crete to Commandaria in Cyprus, sourced from small growers who are self-made and deeply tied to their land. It's a portfolio built as much around education as it is around the wine itself — introducing American drinkers to grapes and regions most haven't encountered before.  
We're proud to bring Diamond Wine Importers' Greek portfolio to our customers, wines that open the door to one of the wine world's most storied — and still under-explored — regions. (show less)

Domaine et Saveurs

Jeanne-Marie de Champs created Domaines et Saveurs Collection in 1994 after 10 years of professional experience in wine. Over the years, thanks to its human size, Domaines et Saveurs has established a relationship of mutual trust with wine growers, merchants and its customers. The rigor in the selection of our estates allows us to offer “terroir” wines with a strong personality, having received excellent tasting notes recognized worldwide. In this privileged relationship of proximity, Domaines et Saveurs Collection operates mainly in Burgundy, in the Loire Valley but also with leaders across France. (show less)

Obvious Wines
A modern, eco-friendly wine brand on a mission to make the world of wine more accessible, sustainable, and fun. Founded in California in 2018, Obvious Wines was born out of a desire ... (read more)
A modern, eco-friendly wine brand on a mission to make the world of wine more accessible, sustainable, and fun. Founded in California in 2018, Obvious Wines was born out of a desire to simplify the wine buying experience — offering high-quality, boutique wines with clear, straightforward labels that speak to flavor, style, and personality.  
Each wine is thoughtfully crafted in collaboration with family-owned vineyards, emphasizing sustainable and organic practices whenever possible. The result is a collection of delicious, well-balanced wines that take the guesswork out of choosing a bottle — without ever compromising on quality.  
From bright, crisp whites to bold, expressive reds, Obvious Wines is all about bringing people together over great wine and good conversation. At Serendipity Wines, we are proud to share their mission and offer these approachable, sustainably made wines that are as enjoyable as they are easy to understand. (show less)

Old Bridge Cellars
Old Bridge Cellars has been a go-to US importer for iconic Australian wine since 1990, when founder Rob McDonald began building relationships with the country's top independent producers. ... (read more)
Old Bridge Cellars has been a go-to US importer for iconic Australian wine since 1990, when founder Rob McDonald began building relationships with the country's top independent producers. The portfolio has since grown to include New Zealand, France, and California, guided throughout by the same standard: fiercely independent winemakers who are regional benchmarks in their own right.  
The Australian core of the book reads like a who's-who of the country's most collected labels — d'Arenberg and Leeuwin Estate among them — with Champagne Collet and Maison L'Envoyé rounding out the French side. The team has earned Wine & Spirits' Importer of the Year recognition more than once, a nod to a book built one long-term grower relationship at a time rather than by chasing volume.  
We're proud to represent Old Bridge Cellars' portfolio in California, wines that critics and collectors have taken seriously for decades. (show less)

Olé & Obrigado is a renowned national wine import company in the US, specializing in bringing exceptional wines and spirits from Spain and Portugal to American enthusiasts. For the last 25 years, business partners Patrick Mata and Alberto Orte have curated a selection of high-quality, diverse wines, aiming to provide a unique and authentic taste of the Iberian Peninsula to consumers across the US while giving back to important causes that are close to their heart. (show less)

Rosenthal Wine Merchant
The Mad Rose Group is a family-run organization that is composed of a close-knit group of people who understand that wine is an agricultural product and that in its best and purest ... (read more)
The Mad Rose Group is a family-run organization that is composed of a close-knit group of people who understand that wine is an agricultural product and that in its best and purest form wine must reflect a specific sense of place. We share the goal of communicating this concept to a growing audience by presenting the finest examples of wine made in the classical western European tradition.  
This endeavor started in 1977 as a humble, one-man retail operation located in New York City but very much outside the mainstream of the wine business. Neal Rosenthal, having stepped away from his corporate and international law practice, conceived of this project. Joined shortly thereafter by his partner, (Ms.) Kerry Madigankerry, the two expanded their fledgling company, known as Rosenthal Wine Merchant (“RWM”), from its retail base to become an importer and distributor of fine wine and specialty food products. (show less)

Serendipity National Sales
Serendipity Imports’ mission is to build and bridge relationships between producers and our distribution partners. Together, we curate a globally diversified portfolio focused on ... (read more)
Serendipity Imports’ mission is to build and bridge relationships between producers and our distribution partners. Together, we curate a globally diversified portfolio focused on wineries, cideries, and distilleries rooted in history of place and a philosophy that emphasizes integration with Mother Nature, committing to regenerative and sustainable practices. Simultaneously, we seek to identify and collaborate with distribution partners that have similar values and demonstrate the passion to bring great products to the market.

Wines from Italy
From the rolling, romantic hills of Piedmont to Sicily’s fiery volcanic slopes, Italy is a sensualist’s dream and a wine lover’s heaven. Nowhere else in the world will you experience such a rich selection of native grapes, each with its own character and flavor, than in Italy. Our partners from the bel paese are small family farms, many of which have roots that reach back centuries. Discover our Italian wines.
Wines from France
Our partners in France are true artisans, looking toward the future while respecting the traditions of the past. We’ve worked with not only mothers and fathers but also sons and daughters—who, after traveling the world, have come home with new ideas. Many of the regions in which we were first pioneers, are today household names—yet we’re still scouring the gorgeous French countryside for the next must-have wine. Discover our French wines.

From the generations of winemakers who pour their lives into their craft, to those enjoying the fruit of their labor - and everyone in between - The Wine Source Inc. takes pride in sharing authentic wines with those that appreciate them.
